mapper.sql: logic_device_unique_id, attr_id, purpose, unit, display_precision, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into asm_config_unit (logic_device_unique_id, attr_id, purpose, unit, display_precision, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{logicDeviceUniqueId}, #{attrId}, #{purpose}, #{unit}, #{displayPrecision}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, now(), now()) on conflict (logic_device_unique_id, attr_id, purpose) do update set unit = excluded.unit, -- precision null=不覆盖已有值（PUT 只改单位不动小数位时保留原配置） display_precision = coalesce(excluded.display_precision, asm_config_unit.display_precision), updated_by = excluded.updated_by, updated_at = now()

insert into asm_config_unit (logic_device_unique_id, attr_id, purpose, unit, display_precision, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{logicDeviceUniqueId}, #{attrId}, #{purpose}, #{unit}, #{displayPrecision}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, now(), now()) on conflict (logic_device_unique_id, attr_id, purpose) do nothing
